title: Orthodontics, environmental sustainability, and the ethics of environmental accounting
html: The 2025 World Federation of Orthodontists (WFO) white paper on the environmental footprint of orthodontic care critically evaluated the impact of orthodontic materials, energy consumption, and waste management practices worldwide.1 Expert orthodontic educators and practitioners provided their perspectives on environmentally sustainable practices with the ultimate goal of minimizing the environmental impact of orthodontics and safeguarding the long-term health of our planet.1 The need for embracing an eco-friendly paradigm shift in how orthodontics should be practiced was highlighted.
